lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Instructor!

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: I've finally got a phone!

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: I knew there was no way I could ever have one while I was in the Rehabilitation Center. > <
It's nice to hear you speaking without the converter.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: You're telling me!

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: The guards over there can't go five minutes without checking their phones,

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: yet inmates aren't allowed to have phones at all. So unfair!
How are you feeling now that you're out?

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Haha!

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: I feel amazing!

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: I'm free at last!

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: I was so over everyone at the center.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: It was starting to get seriously boring.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Now that I'm surrounded by all these young and beautiful people,

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: it's like I've got a new lease on life.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: The world is my oyster!
In that case, what are you hoping to accomplish next?

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Making new friends,

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: of course.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: I was just speaking to everyone a while ago.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: They're all super chill.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: I still haven't fully come out of my shell,

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: but I'm really looking forward to getting to know everyone better.
I'm glad to hear you say that.
Just try and stay out of trouble, okay?

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: You make it sound like

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: you were worried about me before, haha!

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: I hope you won't stop thinking about me now that I'm adjusting so well.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: After all, it's always nice being around someone who has your back.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Don't worry about me.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: As long as we all are in cahoots, there won't be any trouble.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: I'll count you in if we decide to get up to anything fun.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Hehehe.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: I'll talk to you later.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: XOXO
